name: com.anibg/backgrounds
title: AniBG
description: Anime backgrounds without characters: free search and direct links, no auth. Paint with an API key.

tools.name: search_backgrounds
tools.description: Search the AniBG library of free anime backgrounds (scenery without characters). Use it first whenever someone wants an anime background, wallpaper or scene for a visual novel, stream, video call or desktop. Words for a place or a time inside q act as filters, in English, Japanese or Chinese ("night classroom", "rainy shrine", "夜の教室"). Returns up to limit scenes (default 5), each with the picture that answers the query: give the user its url, a permanent 1920x1080 JPG that may be hotlinked. When nothing fits, the result carries a Studio link for the user. Example: {"q": "train station at sunset", "limit": 3}

q.description: Free text: a place, a time of day, things in the picture ("quiet cafe at night", "torii gate").

time.description: Time of day. Rain and snow are made in Studio; search then shows other times and a Studio link.

use.description: Only scenes suited to this use.

offset.description: Skip this many results, for the next page.

lang.description: Language of titles, summaries, place names and texts, and of the page links (ja, zh); English where no translation exists.

tools.name: get_scene
tools.description: One scene by its id (from search_backgrounds): every time of day it comes in with permanent links (1920 JPG, 1280 and 640 WebP), alt text, the light and colours of each, the objects in it, its page and the license. Use it when the user wants another time of day of a scene or details about it. Example: {"id": "bg-001"}

lang.description: Language of titles, summaries and place names, and of the page links (ja, zh); English when absent.

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: Everything the library can be filtered by: the places with how many scenes each has and a cover picture, the times of day, tags, uses and styles. Use it to see what exists before searching or to offer the user a choice. Optional lang (ja, zh) for the names. Example: {}

lang.description: Language of titles, summaries and place names, and of the page links (ja, zh); English when absent.

tools.name: download_image
tools.description: Fetch one picture so you can see it: returns the image itself, plus its permanent links and alt text. Use it only when you need to look (to check a picture suits the user, or to describe it); to hand a picture over, give the user the url from search_backgrounds instead. size 1280 (WebP, usually 100 to 300 KB) is the default and enough to look at; 640 is smaller; 1920 is the full JPG of up to 1 MB and rarely needed. Example: {"id": "bg-001", "time": "night"}

time.description: Time of day; the scene's first time (usually day) when absent. get_scene lists the times a scene has.

tools.name: studio_link
tools.description: A link for the user to make a background the library does not have, in AniBG Studio. The user opens the link, and making a picture costs them credits (or one of two free previews a day). Use it when this connection has no API key (generate_background paints directly when it has one). Either describe a new picture with prompt (with time and aspect), or start from a library scene with scene (with time and want: rain, snow, a 9:16 phone crop or 4k). Example: {"prompt": "quiet train platform in the countryside", "time": "sunset"} or {"scene": "bg-014", "want": "snow"}

prompt.description: What the picture shows, in plain words. Use this or scene.

scene.description: A library scene id, like bg-014, to remake. Use this or prompt.

tools.name: generate_background
tools.description: Paint a new anime background (scenery without characters) with the user's AniBG credits, when search_backgrounds has nothing that fits and the user wants it made. Needs the user's AniBG API key on this connection (header Authorization: Bearer anibg_…); without one the tool says where the user gets it, and studio_link is the way instead. Spends bought credits only: 2K costs 1, 4K costs 2 (free sign-up credits are for Studio). Describe a new place with prompt, or start from a library scene (scene, scene_time) or an earlier picture of the user (job) to change its time of day, shape or size, with prompt for changes. Waits up to wait seconds; if the picture is not done by then, call get_generation with its id. Example: {"prompt": "empty rooftop of a school at dusk, chain-link fence, water tank", "time": "sunset"}

prompt.description: What the place looks like, in plain words, without people. Required unless scene or job is given; with them, what to change.

time.description: Time of day or weather (default day).

scene.description: A library scene id, like bg-014, to start from.

scene_time.description: With scene: which of the scene's pictures to start from (default: time, if the scene has it).

job.description: The id of an earlier picture of this account to start from.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the picture before answering (0 to 55, default 45). Most take 20 to 60 seconds.

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: A picture started with generate_background, by its id: its status, and when done the link to give the user. Needs the same API key. Waits up to wait seconds for it to finish. Example: {"id": "3f9a2c…"}

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the picture before answering (0 to 55, default 30). Most take 20 to 60 seconds.
